svg.aria-label: Figure B1. One lab environment inside your own Microsoft Entra tenant and Azure subscription. You, the Senior Technician or the Tier 1 Technician, work on the lab VM in Microsoft Edge. Step 1: your prompt goes from the lab VM to the agent msp-support-agent in Microsoft Foundry, which runs gpt-5.1 and has its own Microsoft Entra Agent ID. Step 2: the agent grounds its answer on the Azure AI Search index servicedesk-knowledge, built from the Blob export servicedesk-export. Step 3: the agent calls a tool through Azure API Management, Developer tier, which validates your token and adds a correlation ID. Step 4: the MCP server on Azure Container Apps validates the call, write tools run only after you approve them, and its backend secret mcp-backend-key comes from Azure Key Vault, read at startup. Step 5: the MCP server calls Microsoft Dataverse on behalf of the signed-in user; Dataverse applies that user's role and audits the change, which shows in the Service Desk app. Microsoft Purview checks what the tools return. Step 6: Application Insights, Log Analytics and the Dataverse audit all record the same correlation ID.
